name: Nebraska

rule.textEn: Anyone born after Dec. 31, 1985 must pass a commission-approved boating safety course and hold the certificate to run any motorboat or PWC.
rule.textEs: Quien nació después del 31 de diciembre de 1985 debe aprobar un curso de seguridad náutica aprobado por la comisión y tener el certificado para manejar cualquier lancha o moto acuática.

minAge.note: No one under 14 may operate a motorboat or PWC; under 16 may not tow a person.

card.feeNote: By law the commission may charge no more than $10 for the required course.

nonResident: Visitors may use a NASBLA-approved certificate accepted by their home state; Nebraska residents must take the Nebraska course.
rental: Renters born after Dec. 31, 1985 also need proof of a boating safety course.
pwcExtra: Under 16 may not tow anyone behind a motorboat or PWC.

sources.quote: Effective January 1, 2012, no person born after December 31, 1985, shall operate a motorboat or personal watercraft on the waters of this state unless he or she has successfully completed a boating safety course approved by the commission and has been issued a valid boating safety certificate.
No person under fourteen years of age shall operate a motorboat or personal watercraft on the waters of this state.
No person under sixteen years of age shall operate a motorboat or personal watercraft on the waters of this state with an individual in tow
The commission may charge a fee of no more than ten dollars for a boating safety course required by this section.

sources.publisher: Nebraska Game and Parks Commission, Boating FAQ
sources.quote: Nebraska law requires any boat operator born after December 31, 1985 to successfully complete a boating education course.

sources.publisher: Nebraska Game and Parks Commission, Boating FAQ
sources.quote: there is no charge for a replacement card.

sources.publisher: Nebraska Game and Parks Commission, Boating FAQ
sources.quote: A certificate from another state is acceptable provided it is for a NASBLA-approved course and accepted by your home state (for non-residents). Residents of Nebraska must successfully complete the  Nebraska course .

sources.publisher: Nebraska Game and Parks Commission, Boating FAQ
sources.quote: When renting any craft powered by gas, diesel, or electric in Nebraska, boaters born after December 31, 1985 must have proof of successful completion of a  boating safety class .

sources.publisher: Nebraska Game and Parks Commission, Boating FAQ
sources.quote: Having a drivers license (for driving a car) has nothing to do with being capable of, or legally allowed to, operate a boat.
